topic: Updating retirement beneficiary designations after divorce vs leaving them stale (Warren vs Talia)

scenes.narration: His will left everything to his children. His ex-wife received four hundred thousand instead. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at a chart where a will is overruled by a dusty form stamped BENEFICIARY, comic burst banner reads BENEFICIARY CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Warren and Talia both divorced and both wrote brand new wills.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man warren and woman talia each signing a fresh document stamped NEW WILL, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each will leaves everything to their children. Clean and clear.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two wills held open, each line stamped EVERYTHING TO MY CHILDREN, doctor's office background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: But retirement accounts do not follow your will at all.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a clipboard showing an arrow from a will bouncing off a retirement vault, tag reads WILL DOES NOT APPLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: They follow the dusty beneficiary form you signed many years ago.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a dusty yellowed form stamped BENEFICIARY FORM SIGNED YEARS AGO sitting inside the retirement vault, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That form legally overrides whatever your will happens to say.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, the beneficiary form stamped OVERRIDES THE WILL sitting on top of a will, a judge's stamp beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Talia logs in and updates every beneficiary the same week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman talia at a laptop clicking a field stamped UPDATE BENEFICIARY, a calendar marked THIS WEEK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Warren assumes his new will quietly handled everything for him.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man warren relaxing with his will in hand, a thought chart above reads ASSUMED IT WAS HANDLED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Warren dies. His four hundred thousand dollar retirement account pays his ex.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a retirement vault stamped FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND emptying into an envelope labeled TO THE EX SPOUSE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His children inherit nothing from it. The courts cannot help.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two grown children holding an empty envelope, a courthouse door stamped NOTHING WE CAN DO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Talia's children receive her accounts exactly as she actually intended.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman talia's grown children receiving a sealed envelope stamped EXACTLY AS INTENDED, warm exam room lighting, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Update beneficiaries on every account after any life change. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading UPDATE YOUR BENEFICIARIES, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
